remarks: This Old (New) Smart House! No detail has been overlooked in this beautiful antique home, completely restored with grace and charm at every turn. From the eat-in kitchen with walnut island, soapstone countertops, and authentic English hardware, to the cozy and comfortable layout of the indoor and outdoor spaces, you'll feel right at home here. The family room flows into living and sunroom, with formal dining room, library and powder room on the main floor. Four+ bedrooms plus two offices and 3 baths on the upper levels, all recently refurbished. The wraparound porch and painted latticework is reminiscent of the lovely Charleston/New Orleans charisma that carries through the interiors, with a carefully curated fresh take on historic paint colors, moldings, flooring and decor. The outdoor kitchen with built-in Weber grill and wood-burning fieldstone fireplace, surrounded by Connecticut bluestone patio make for an all-season getaway right outside the back door. The freeform pool and surrounding patio and landscaping make a sunny oasis to soak up the good life!
